Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to execute the search query within the Vaughan Williams Memorial Library (VWML) website. Instead of typing the nursery rhyme into the search bar or navigating to the specific search interface, it typed the query string into the cookie consent banner ("Set cookie preferences"). This resulted in no search being performed, leaving the task incomplete and preventing the retrieval of the Roud Folk Song Index number. This is a critical execution error where the agent interacted with the wrong UI element (cookie banner) instead of the intended one (search bar).
